author: B Kumar
text:
Micro1 is Hiring for 
AI Workflow Specialist,
Fully Remote, On Contract basis.

Role Description As an AI Workflow Specialist at micro1, you will design, optimize, and document end-to-end workflows for training and evaluating RL models in real-world environments. You will collaborate with data engineers, ML researchers, and product teams to translate experimental setups into scalable pipelines, ensuring consistent data ingestion, environment configuration, model training, and performance monitoring. Daily responsibilities include mapping requirements, defining process steps, configuring tools, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and communicating status and improvements to stakeholders. You will also help standardize best practices, identify bottlenecks, and propose automation opportunities to increase reliability and efficiency. This is a remote contract role, requiring effective independent work, clear communication, and the ability to align workflows with project timelines and quality standards.

Qualifications
 
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning workflows, ideally including reinforcement learning concepts and experimentation pipelines.
Experience designing and documenting technical processes, including data flows, environment setups, and model training or evaluation steps.
Proficiency with common data and ML tooling (e.g., Python-based workflows, version control systems, experiment tracking or orchestration tools).
Ability to analyze operational bottlenecks, propose workflow improvements, and support implementation in collaboration with technical teams.
Comfort working in remote, cross-functional environments with clear, concise written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, structured thinking, and a systematic approach to process design and quality assurance.
Prior experience in AI/ML, data engineering, or technical operations is highly beneficial; exposure to RL environments or simulation platforms is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.

Email your resume in PDF format immediately to biju24934@gmail.com
